name: Mona Lisa 100K Euclidean traveling salesman tour

parameters.tour: one Hamiltonian cycle through all cities
parameters.objective: sum of integer edge lengths, including return edge

source_review.definition: Fixed 100000-city TSPLIB MonaLisa100K minimum closed Hamiltonian tour, integer EUC_2D distances. The scalar is the sum of individually rounded edges, not the rounded sum of real distances.
source_review.source: Read official live page: Nagata genetic algorithm March17 2009 tour5757191, reported Concorde lower5757084 July27 2012, gap107. Cook, Helsgaun, Hougardy and Schroeder2024 Local elimination DOI10.1007/s12532-024-00262-y §3.1 explicitly calls this instance unproved. No full Concorde lower-bound recertification claimed.
source_review.independent: Root independently downloaded exact TSPLIB1658328bytes SHA532fefbfb9ad66cc2550bece766fa069acaa8e34ee511ac1949ae101da4d70ad and official689030byte tour SHAd8a98a936d01b0317ff63a43646fbbbfa74bf6ee954a9449ad659128e579eb88. Checked all cities once and all100000 closing edges. Admission independently parses raw coordinates and binary-searches midpoint inequalities, separate from checker isqrt method.
source_review.isolation: Initial ID ordering, baseline spatial bands and bounded local2opt, evolution alias baseline use only public coordinates, no comparison witness. Cold export whitelists only input coordinates. All strict five runs, full-return score invariance, broken permutation, replay and failure controls passed.
source_review.limits: Reference result verified; published lower bound only reported. No optimality claim. Formal100000 input avoids materializing full distance matrix. Distinct from CVRP capacity/route-count model.
